claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly but no readable import/VIN/label or documentation indicating Belgium origin.
No running video, no test results (compression/leak-down), and no audio/diagnostic evidence in the photos.
No odometer/ECU readout, no mileage label, and no engine number/VIN visible to verify usage.
Photos do not show tamper evidence (seal marks, opened fasteners, or service history) clearly enough to confirm.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts.
claims.evidence: This is a general business statement; photos do not confirm inventory specifics.

risks.risk: Engine make/model and compatibility are unknown; wrong engine for the buyer’s car could make it unusable or require extra swaps.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification (engine code/label) and/or VIN/engine number plate, plus a shot showing the full engine assembly part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unidentified used engine assembly with suspension struts included, with compatibility risk treated as worst-case.

risks.risk: Condition is unproven (no running/test evidence). Internal damage (knock, low compression, oil/coolant leaks) may exist even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running (cold start if possible) and/or compression test and leak-down test results with readings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not verified working; treated as potentially needing overhaul/repairs.

risks.risk: Completeness is uncertain: photos may not show missing sensors, wiring connectors, turbo/exhaust parts, mounts, or ancillary components.
risks.proof: A full inventory checklist photo/clip laid out (all sensors, hoses, brackets, turbo/exhaust components) and a photo of every connector/port to confirm nothing is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly incomplete; worst-case assumes missing/extra parts may need replacement.

risks.risk: Turbo/exhaust-related components may be damaged (e.g., seized turbo, cracked housings) but not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of turbo compressor/turbine housings and shaft play check (video showing shaft movement) plus any visible cracks/soot patterns.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with turbo/exhaust condition treated as unknown and potentially faulty.

risks.risk: Suspension strut/spring units shown may be worn, leaking, or mismatched; engine assembly includes struts but their condition affects overall value.
risks.proof: Photos of strut bodies for oil leakage, rust severity, spring condition, and mounting points; ideally a short clip showing no obvious damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used suspension components of unknown condition (worst-case wear).

risks.risk: No fluid condition evidence: oil/coolant contamination or sludge can indicate poor maintenance or internal issues.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of oil fill/dipstick area (if accessible), coolant reservoir/radiator hose ends (if present), and any drain/flush evidence.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown fluid condition; treated as requiring inspection/flush.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine identification label/engine code (and any VIN/engine number plate).
Video of the engine running (cold start preferred) showing no abnormal noise and stable idle.
Compression test and/or leak-down test results with readings (and date).
Photos/clip confirming completeness: every sensor, connector, hoses, mounts, turbo/exhaust components, and any included transmission/ancillaries (if applicable).
Close-ups of turbo/exhaust housings and a video showing turbo shaft play (if turbo is included).
Photos of strut/spring units showing any oil leakage, cracks, and mounting condition.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it’s a used engine assembly with strut/spring units, but the key value drivers (make/model, completeness, and whether it truly runs/tested) are not verifiable from the provided images. Without at least engine identification and working/test evidence, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
